description: Speech-quality QA for a voice recording: speech/silence ratio, speaking-rate label, signal-to-noise, noise floor, pause energy, sibilance risk, clipping severity. Gates a voice take. Status: levels, SNR, noise floor and clipping are validated against known signals; speaking rate, background scene and intelligibility are proxies, and the pause-energy field is not a reverb measure (https://audiolab.tools/lenses). The answer carries measureStatus: per field its status (validated, proxy, beta, withdrawn), basis and margin where known. Report a proxy as an approximation, never present a withdrawn field as what its name says, and stay inside a stated margin (https://audiolab.tools/docs/start/read-a-response#the-five-statuses). Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

measureStatus.description: Add measureStatus to the answer: the status of each field. On by default; set false to leave it out.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine. It is read here and uploaded to the AudioLab API for measuring, so you do not need to host it publicly (files up to 4 MB go in the request body; larger ones, up to 150 MB, upload over a signed URL and are swept from storage within the hour). Provide exactly one of url or path.

round.description: Round numbers to what they are worth (dB and LUFS 2 decimals, seconds 3, ms 1, Hz 1, shares 3); same keys and types. On by default; set false for full precision.

series.description: Include the curves and arrays (a large payload). Off by default.

speechDetector.description: Speech detector: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or k2 (lets a phrase run on into its soft word starts and endings, at most 100 ms per side).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

name: analyze_voice
title: Analyze voice quality (VoiceLab)
